title: Word Form: -ive, -al, -ly
topic: Mengenali kata sifat dan kata keterangan dari akhiran -ive, -al, dan -ly
objectives: Mengenali kata sifat yang berakhiran -ive, -al, dan -ly
Membentuk kata keterangan dengan -ly dari kata sifat
Memilih bentuk kata sifat atau keterangan sesuai posisinya dalam kalimat

block1.tip: Akhiran -ive, -al, dan -ly bisa menunjukkan kata sifat atau kata keterangan. Lihat posisinya: kata sifat menerangkan kata benda, dan kata keterangan menerangkan kata kerja, sifat, atau keterangan lain.

keywords: word form suffix ive al ly
youtube.videoDescription: Video 10 sampai 15 menit tentang akhiran -ive, -al, dan -ly, dengan contoh kata sifat dan kata keterangan.
watchFor: Posisi kata sifat sebelum kata benda

lesson.intro: Akhiran menentukan jenis kata. Kata sifat menerangkan kata benda, sedangkan kata keterangan menerangkan kata kerja. Akhiran -ly sering dipakai untuk membentuk kata keterangan, tetapi ada juga kata sifat yang berakhiran -ly, seperti friendly.

sections.heading: Akhiran -ive dan -al
sections.bodyMd: Akhiran **-ive** dan **-al** biasanya membentuk kata sifat: **create** menjadi **creative**, **effect** menjadi **effective**, **person** menjadi **personal**, **globe** menjadi **global**.

sections.heading: Akhiran -ly
sections.bodyMd: Akhiran **-ly** mengubah kata sifat menjadi kata keterangan: **quick** menjadi **quickly**, **careful** menjadi **carefully**. Hati-hati: **friendly** adalah kata sifat, bukan kata keterangan.

sections.heading: Posisi yang benar
sections.bodyMd: Kata sifat ditaruh sebelum kata benda atau setelah **be**: **a creative idea**, **the idea is creative**. Kata keterangan dengan -ly ditaruh setelah kata kerja: **She speaks positively**.

formulas.pattern: be + kata sifat (the plan is effective)

formulas.label: Ly sifat
formulas.pattern: friendly, lovely, lonely: kata sifat dengan -ly

block3.title: Mural untuk Kota
block3.text:
A small town recently launched a creative project that aimed to bring people together. The organizers believed that an effective plan needed to include everyone, so they invited families, students, and local artists. Their positive attitude helped the project grow quickly. Soon the idea attracted attention from a national newspaper, and later, the story was shared by a global website.

The first meeting was lively. Some participants were shy, which is typical in a new group, but the organizers created a relaxed space. Each person was asked to describe a personal memory of the town. These short stories became the basis of a mural painted on the wall of the old market. The physical work took three weekends, and every volunteer brought a different skill.

Not every idea was accepted. One suggestion was logical but too expensive for the budget, so the team chose a simpler design. A critical part of the discussion focused on the safety of the scaffolding. The leaders invited an engineer to check the structure, and his advice was clear and practical.

Local shops also helped by donating paint and food. The bakery sent bread every morning, and a family restaurant prepared lunch for the workers. These gifts made the work feel warm and generous. The mayor visited the wall and said the result was both beautiful and meaningful.

Today, the mural is one of the most visited places in the town. The organizers say the success came from a simple habit: they listened carefully to everyone. Their message is that community projects work best when they are inclusive, respectful, and honest about their limits.
